mapper.sql: select task_id, task_type, document_id, document_name, collection_id, collection_name, model_id, status, progress, stage, message, error_message, request_payload, cancel_requested, retry_count, start_time, end_time, create_by, create_time, remark from ai_knowledge_task
mapper.select: select count(*) from ai_knowledge_task where collection_id = #{collectionId} and status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: update ai_knowledge_task set status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, stage = #{stage}, message = #{message}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, start_time = coalesce(start_time, #{startTime}), end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId}
update ai_knowledge_task set cancel_requested = '1', message = '已请求取消，等待当前步骤结束', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')

update ai_knowledge_task set status = 'FAILED', stage = 'INTERRUPTED', message = '服务重启，任务已中断，可重试', error_message = '服务重启导致任务中断', end_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
